text: 展望后市，西部证券首席策略分析师曹柳龙认为资本市场改革持续显效，大盘蓝筹股估值不高，中长期来看对A股市场不必悲观。曹柳龙表示，证券基金保险互换便利为机构提供流动性支持的可靠渠道，回购增持专项再贷款为上市公司与主要股东带来真金白银的资金来源，两项工具在市场承压期间有效阻断了负向螺旋、修复机构增持意愿；随着相关工具利率下调并转为长期性安排，市场的自我稳定能力有了制度依托。
text_en: Looking ahead, Cao Liulong, chief strategist at Western Securities, believes capital market reforms continue to show results and large-cap blue-chip valuations are not high, so there is no need to be pessimistic about the A-share market in the medium to long term. Cao said the securities-fund-insurance swap facility provides institutions with a reliable channel for liquidity support, while the special relending facility for buybacks and increases gives listed companies and major shareholders a source of real funds; the two tools effectively blocked negative spirals and restored institutions' willingness to increase holdings during market stress; as the rates on the relevant tools are cut and they become long-term arrangements, the market's self-stabilizing capacity has an institutional foundation.
